method.endpoint: CLI invocation to results ready plus compositor mapping; search is keyboard command to result-model update, not frame presentation
method.caches: OS caches retained; one unmeasured launch per frontend/renderer primes application caches
method.memory: sum PSS of frontend and all descendant backend/helpers; compositor excluded
method.cpu: no polling during idle sample; percent of one CPU core
method.instrumentation: private QML copy adds read-only query/busy/rows fields to status; no production changes
method.limitations: Both frontends use layer-shell; measures launcher list workload, not full provider parity; no physical frame latency or GPU memory measured

correctness: Ordered IDs and totals agree across every query, frontend, trial and renderer
